name: chunks_to_symbols_bc_bpsk
description: chunks_to_symbols_bc with the points of constellation_bpsk

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Table lookup: GNU Radio holds the points as complex<float> computed in float32, ours are float32 roundings of float64 values. Per component the two differ by a few float32 ulps of a value below 1.5 (ulp 1.2e-7), so the complex magnitude differs by under 5e-7 (measured 3.5e-7).

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Constants rounded to the nearest multiple of 2^-14: error at most 2^-15 per component, sqrt(2) times that in magnitude; the lookup adds none.
Constants rounded to the nearest multiple of 2^-10 (table values are always rounded, whatever the rounding option says): error at most 2^-11 per component, sqrt(2) times that in magnitude.
